title: MarketAnalyzerItems
description: Shape of content.items for L1-vision-market-analyzer. This agent produces no separate document — items carry the FULL, authoritative competitive-intelligence, market-sizing, industry-trends, customer-insights, pricing-benchmarks, and SWOT narrative directly; there is no artifact to retrieve for more detail. Citation, id, status, and confidence fields are structural, not prose duplication, and stay in full — gr-L1-citation-verifier is a BLOCKER guardrail here, not advisory. Every individual claim across all five dimensions must carry its own citation; where no grounded data exists, the agent reports that gap honestly (a low-confidence entry with reasoning stating the gap, or an empty array) rather than fabricating a plausible-sounding figure.

market_sizing.description: TAM/SAM/SOM-style sizing for the relevant market segment. A single structured estimate, not a list — each of tam/sam/som is itself one figure with its own basis and citation. If a figure genuinely cannot be grounded (no KB or search support), still include the sub-object with a low confidence and a reasoning field stating the gap explicitly — never omit tam/sam/som or fabricate a number to fill it.

industry_trends.description: First-class, citable industry-trend items — promoted from what was previously only implicit SWOT-derived context. Every trend still carries its own citation even when it also informs a SWOT item.

customer_insights.description: Market-research-lens findings about WHAT target users' needs, pain points, and behaviors are — distinct from L1-vision-idea-intake's target_users, which identifies WHO they are.

pricing_benchmarks.description: What comparable products/competitors charge, and the pricing model in use (commission, subscription, listing fee, transaction fee, etc.).

rationale.description: Full rationale for the sufficiency verdict — this is the only place this content lives, there is no separate document. Since this agent now covers five dimensions (competitive intelligence, market sizing, industry trends, customer insights, pricing benchmarks), the rationale should note which dimensions had adequate grounding and which were thin, not just give one overall verdict — a dimension with only a low-confidence gap-flagging entry should be named as thin here even if the overall status is 'sufficient' on balance.

source_reference.description: KB chunk id (kb-L2-domain-market) or a web-search result reference from tool-L1-web-search-competitor-scan

name.description: Competitor name — not prose, kept in full

positioning.description: Full positioning statement for this competitor — this is the only place this content lives, there is no separate document

strengths.description: Full strengths statement for this competitor — this is the only place this content lives, there is no separate document

weaknesses.description: Full weaknesses statement for this competitor — this is the only place this content lives, there is no separate document

statement.description: Full SWOT statement — this is the only place this content lives, there is no separate document

reasoning.description: Must reference which competitor_matrix entry or idea-brief fact this derives from

value.description: Full sizing figure, e.g. '£2.1bn' — a range is acceptable, e.g. '£30-35bn'

basis.description: Full methodology/scope statement for this figure — what population or spend it covers and how it was derived or sourced

reasoning.description: Why this figure applies here; if no grounded figure exists, state that gap explicitly instead of fabricating a number

statement.description: Full trend statement — this is the only place this content lives, there is no separate document

reasoning.description: Why this trend is relevant to the stated problem/target users

insight.description: Full insight statement — a need, pain point, or behavior, not who the users are (that's target_users' job upstream)

segment.description: Which stakeholder this relates to, e.g. 'buyer-side', 'producer-side' — free text, not a fixed enum, since target_users upstream is itself free text

reasoning.description: Why this insight is relevant, and its grounding

price_point.description: Full price-point statement, e.g. '2-4% commission per transaction'

reasoning.description: Why this benchmark applies here, and its grounding
